QUOTE: Runtime (function pointers)... Call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`... Compile time (macros). Define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... the runtime setter is compiled out (`platform.c:20-22`). The macros take precedence if both styles are configured.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes the two styles, but it says the macros "take precedence if both styles are configured." That treats them as combinable, not as mutually exclusive.
